item.text: The packet contains 110 items across six query families. I’ll combine the pack membership tables with matching `document.pack_field` values; the schema does not specify precedence between them, so I’ll flag that interpretation in the report.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re
from collections import Counter

with open('packet.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    packet = json.load(f)

members = \"\"\"submitted(cr, pack_id) AS (
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
    UNION
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
    UNION
    SELECT pd.id, pp.id
    FROM document AS pd
    JOIN cr_pack AS pp ON pp.pack_number = pd.pack_field
)\"\"\"
modifications = \"\"\"modifies(cr, section_id) AS (
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
    UNION
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
)\"\"\"
pack_joins = \"\"\"FROM document AS d
JOIN submitted AS sp ON sp.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = sp.pack_id\"\"\"
decision_joins = \"\"\"JOIN disposition AS ds ON ds.target = d.id
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = ds.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id\"\"\"
section_joins = \"\"\"JOIN modifies AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id\"\"\"
verified = [\"ds.evidence_status = 'source_verified'\", \"ds.scope = 'whole_target'\", \"m.wg = 'RAN1'\"]
expressions = {
    'document': 'd.number',
    'final_document': 'd.number',
    'disposition': 'ds.code',
    'wg_meeting': 'm.label',
    'cr_pack': 'p.pack_number',
    'tsg_meeting': 'p.tsg_meeting',
    'clause': 's.clause',
}

def literal(value):
    return \"'\" + value.replace(\"'\", \"''\") + \"'\"

def build(fields, ctes, joins, conditions, recursive=False):
    projection = ', '.join(expressions[field] + ' AS \"' + field + '\"' for field in fields)
    return ('WITH ' + ('RECURSIVE ' if recursive else '') + ',\\n'.join(ctes)
            + '\\nSELECT DISTINCT ' + projection + '\\n' + '\\n'.join(joins)
            + '\\nWHERE ' + '\\n  AND '.join(conditions) + ';')

rows = []
families = Counter()
for item in packet['items']:
    q = item['question']
    fields = item['fields']
    ctes = [members]
    joins = [pack_joins]
    conditions = []
    recursive = False
    if q.startswith('In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request '):
        family = 'pack_lookup'
        match = re.fullmatch(r'In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request (R1-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.]+)\\) submitted\\? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        number, cr_number, spec = match.groups()
        expected_fields = ['cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting']
        conditions = ['d.number = ' + literal(number)]
    elif q.startswith('Change request '):
        family = 'decision_pack'
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Change request (R1-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.]+)\\) was handled by RAN1\\. What source-verified disposition did RAN1 record for the whole document and at which RAN1 meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted\\? Give the disposition, the RAN1 meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        number, cr_number, spec = match.groups()
        expected_fields = ['disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting']
        joins.append(decision_joins)
        conditions = ['d.number = ' + literal(number)] + verified
    elif q.startswith('Trace change request '):
        family = 'decision_sections'
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Trace change request (R1-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.]+)\\) from the RAN1 decision to the clauses it modifies\\. Give the source-verified disposition RAN1 recorded for the whole document, the RAN1 meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS ([\\d.]+) that the CR modifies\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        number, cr_number, spec, section_spec = match.groups()
        assert spec == section_spec, item['id']
        expected_fields = ['disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting', 'clause']
        ctes.append(modifications)
        joins.extend([decision_joins, section_joins])
        conditions = ['d.number = ' + literal(number), 's.spec = ' + literal(section_spec)] + verified
    elif q.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack '):
        family = 'pack_decisions'
        match = re.fullmatch(r'TSG RAN CR pack (RP-\\d+) carries change requests from RAN1\\. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN1 meeting\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        pack_number = match.group(1)
        expected_fields = ['document', 'disposition', 'wg_meeting']
        joins.append(decision_joins)
        conditions = ['p.pack_number = ' + literal(pack_number), \"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\"] + verified
    elif q.startswith('Which Rel-'):
        family = 'release_clause'
        match = re.fullmatch(r'Which (Rel-\\d+) change requests that modify clause ([\\d.A-Za-z]+) of TS ([\\d.]+) have a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN1 meeting, and the CR pack document number\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        release, clause, spec = match.groups()
        expected_fields = ['document', 'disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack']
        ctes.append(modifications)
        joins.extend([decision_joins, section_joins])
        conditions = [\"d.doc_type = 'tdoc:CR'\", 'd.target_release = ' + literal(release),
                      's.release = ' + literal(release), 's.spec = ' + literal(spec),
                      's.clause = ' + literal(clause)] + verified
    elif q.startswith('RAN1 recorded document '):
        family = 'revision_pack'
        match = re.fullmatch(r'RAN1 recorded document (R1-\\d+) as revised\\. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack\\. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number\\.', q)
        assert match, item['id']
        origin = 'tdoc:' + match.group(1)
        expected_fields = ['final_document', 'disposition', 'cr_pack']
        recursive = True
        ctes.insert(0, \"later_versions(id) AS (\\n    SELECT later FROM revision WHERE earlier = \" + literal(origin)
                    + \"\\n    UNION\\n    SELECT rv.later\\n    FROM revision AS rv\\n    JOIN later_versions AS lv ON rv.earlier = lv.id\\n)\")
        joins.extend(['JOIN later_versions AS lv ON lv.id = d.id', decision_joins])
        conditions = ['d.id <> ' + literal(origin)] + verified
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Unrecognized item: ' + item['id'])
    assert fields == expected_fields, item['id']
    sql = build(fields, ctes, joins, conditions, recursive)
    assert sql.startswith(('WITH ', 'SELECT ')), item['id']
    assert sql.count('SELECT DISTINCT ') == 1, item['id']
    projection = sql.split('SELECT DISTINCT ', 1)[1].split('\\nFROM ', 1)[0]
    assert re.findall(r' AS \"(["'^"]+)"'"', projection) == fields, item['id']
    rows.append({'id': item['id'], 'sql': sql})
    families[family] += 1

with open('queries.jsonl', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for row in rows:
        f.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\n')

with open('queries.jsonl', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    lines = f.read().splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(packet['items'])
parsed = [json.loads(line) for line in lines]
assert all(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == {'id', 'sql'} for row in parsed)
assert [row['id'] for row in parsed] == [item['id'] for item in packet['items']]
assert all(isinstance(row['sql'], str) and row['sql'] for row in parsed)
print('Lines written:', len(lines))
print('Check: passed')
print('Families:', dict(families))
PY"
